integrity: Proof is analytic; a separately executable exact symbolic checker verifies all six Gram spectra and the 84-mask combinatorial partition. No numerical truncated theta series is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Dimension three, equally weighted three-atom masks, positive real symmetric windows; the result optimizes the lower frame bound, not the condition number, and does not cover higher dimensions. Possible unindexed historical priority remains.
title: Six universal optimal critical Gabor sampling masks and a sharp Gaussian width-uniform bound
